_about: Hand-written from the code (base values, no upgrades). description: what the spell does (popup); tags: chips; detail (optional): note (faded text under the tags), sections (title, text, formulas, tags; "@penalty" stands for the shared Ascension penalty formula) and tier_sections (the bonus the spell gets at higher tiers). The tiers, their requirements, the tier cost and the offline bonus are generated by tools/build_spells_page.py from the Magic upgrades.

Blood Frenzy.description: Increase the production of all Evil buildings for its duration.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Increases the production of all Evil buildings while it is active.

vars: the production multiplier of each Evil building
the base bonus, $1500\%$ by default, changed by various effects, e.g. Demon Bloodline
the Ascension penalty exponent, 1 at Ascension 0

sections.title: Ascension penalty
sections.text: The Evil building bonus is reduced by the Ascension penalty, which lowers the exponent p above. The bonus of higher tiers is not.

tier_sections.title: Bonus at higher tiers
tier_sections.text: Casting it at a higher tier also increases the production of all Non-Unique buildings, whatever their alignment. The Ascension penalty does not apply to this bonus.

vars: the production bonus of each Non-Unique building, in %
the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

Brainwave.description: Increase the production of all buildings by a cumulative percentage per second, based on time passed.

Call to Arms.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on buildings built.

Combo Strike.description: Increase the production of all buildings by a progressively higher value as you continue casting this spell. The duration of the spell cannot be modified.

Diamond Pickaxe.description: Increase clicking reward based on Excavation depth and increase your Faction Coin find chance.

Fairy Chanting.description: Increase the production of Farms, Inns and Blacksmiths based on the amounts built.

Gem Grinder.description: Multiplicatively increase the production bonus from Gems.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Multiplies the production bonus you get from Gems while it is active. The bonus grows with the tier it is cast at.

vars: the multiplier of the production bonus from Gems
the base bonus, $2500\%$ by default, changed by various effects, e.g. Faceless Bloodline
the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

tier_sections.title: Bonus at higher tiers
tier_sections.text: Casting it at a higher tier also increases the Royal Exchange bonus. This bonus is not reduced by the Ascension penalty.

vars: the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

Goblin's Greed.description: Instantly produce Faction Coins based on Gems owned.

God's Hand.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on your Mana Regeneration. The duration increases with time spent as Good in this Reincarnation.

Grand Balance.description: Increase the production of your least productive buildings based on the three most built ones.

Hellfire Blast.description: Increase the production of Evil Fortresses based on your amount of trophies.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Increases the reward of every click while it is active.

vars: the base bonus, $1750\%$ by default, changed by various effects, e.g. Angel Bloodline
the Ascension penalty exponent, 1 at Ascension 0

sections.title: Ascension penalty
sections.text: The click reward bonus is reduced by the Ascension penalty, which lowers the exponent p above. The bonus of higher tiers is not.

tier_sections.title: Bonus at higher tiers
tier_sections.text: Casting it at a higher tier also increases your Mana Regeneration. The Ascension penalty does not apply to this bonus.

vars: the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

Lightning Strike.description: The production of a random building is increased based on the amount of Iron Strongholds owned.

Moon Blessing.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on clicks made in this Reincarnation. Autoclick 15 times per second.

Night Time.description: The production of assistants is increased based on Necropolises owned.

Spiritual Surge.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on Reincarnations made.

Tax Collection.description: Instantly gain some seconds' worth of coin production from buildings and assistants.

Hailstorm.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on Hailstorm activity time. The bonus increases progressively over the duration of the spell.

Heatwave.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on spells cast in this Era.

Dragon's Breath.description: Activates one of six effects at random: Red, Green, Blue, White, Black or Yellow.

Cannibalize.description: Increase Faction Coin find chance based on the total amount of Bones collected and Reincarnations made.

Shadow Embrace.description: Increase the size of your assistant army based on Reincarnations made. Increases progressively as you continue casting this spell.

Wail of the Banshee.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on mana produced in this Era and Reincarnations made.

Temporal Flux.description: Increase the production of Unique Buildings based on time spent in this Era.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Increases the production of all Unique Buildings, and your offline production, based on the time spent in this Era. It also increases Mana Regeneration and Maximum Mana, more so the higher the tier it is cast at.

vars: the production multiplier of each Unique Building
the Ascension penalty exponent, 1 at Ascension 0
the time spent in this Era, in seconds
the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

sections.title: Ascension penalty
sections.text: The Unique Building production bonus and the offline production bonus are reduced by the Ascension penalty, which lowers the exponent p above. The Mana Regeneration and Maximum Mana bonuses are not.

tier_sections.title: Bonus at higher tiers
tier_sections.text: Casting it at a higher tier also makes the mana you produce count more. The Ascension penalty does not apply to these.

vars: the bonus to the mana produced count, in %
the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

All Creation.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on your Mana Regeneration.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Increases the production of all buildings based on your Mana Regeneration, and increases your Faction Coin find chance. The Faction Coin bonus grows with the tier it is cast at.

vars: the production multiplier of every building
the Ascension penalty exponent, 1 at Ascension 0
your Mana Regeneration per second (some upgrades use the highest Mana Regeneration of this Reincarnation instead)
the Faction Coin find chance bonus, in %
the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

sections.title: Ascension penalty
sections.text: The production bonus is reduced by the Ascension penalty, which lowers the exponent p above. The Faction Coin bonus is not.

tier_sections.title: Bonus at higher tiers
tier_sections.text: Casting it at a higher tier also increases the production bonus from Gems. The Ascension penalty does not apply to these.

vars: the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

Maelstrom.description: Increase the production of two random buildings based on one of these stats in this Era, chosen at random: mana produced, trophies unlocked, Faction Coins found or amount of assistants.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Increases the production of two random buildings based on one stat of this Era, chosen at random. Each tier above the first adds one more random building.

vars: the production multiplier of an affected building
the Ascension penalty exponent, 1 at Ascension 0

formulas.latex: X = \begin{cases} 0.1 \cdot \ln(1 + m)^{5} & \text{mana produced} \\ 5 \cdot N^{0.9} & \text{trophies unlocked} \\ 0.01 \cdot \ln(1 + f)^{4} & \text{Faction Coins found} \\ 0.1 \cdot \ln(1 + a)^{5} & \text{amount of assistants} \end{cases}
vars: the mana produced in this Era
the trophies unlocked in this Era
the Faction Coins found in this Era

sections.title: Ascension penalty
sections.text: The production bonus is reduced by the Ascension penalty, which lowers the exponent p above.

tier_sections.title: Bonus at higher tiers
tier_sections.text: Casting it at a higher tier affects more buildings.

vars: the tier the spell is cast at (1 for a spell cast once)

Infinite Spiral.description: Increase the production of all buildings by a percentage each second, up to its maximum duration. Temporarily increase assistants based on Maximum Mana.

Limited Wish.description: Provide a random effect based on your chosen alignment. The duration of the spell cannot be modified, but its cost decreases by 1% per minute up to 1 hour, then it resets. Its power increases as you continue casting this spell.

Precognition.description: Buildings, Assistants, Royal Exchanges, Spells cast and Clicks count more, based on mana produced in this Era.

Catalyst.description: Activates two random Vanilla or base alignment spells.

Chaos Madness.description: Grants the effect of a random lineage, with the level of your highest lineage.

Twisting Nether.description: Lineage levels count more for its duration.

detail.note: * Only a Pseudo-Faction spell if obtained from the Fairy/Angel legacy combo.
